nodes.name: Button.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable button component with variant (default/positive/negative/warning/info/neutral) and size (sm/md/lg) props. Renders a styled <button> with active state support. Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props) and a Snippet for children content. Extensive CSS with color-coded variants using rgba tones.

nodes.name: RollValue.svelte
nodes.summary: Animated numeric value display component. When the input value changes, it smoothly interpolates between old and new numeric values using requestAnimationFrame with ease-in-out timing. Parses numeric strings with prefix/suffix, handles decimals, and colors negative values red. Uses Svelte 4 export syntax.

nodes.name: uiConstants.ts
nodes.summary: Central UI constants file defining color palettes and labels for the application. Exports UI_COLORS (damage type colors, tag group colors, source type colors, enchant rarity colors, negative stat colors), SOURCE_LABELS (rune/perk/weaponArt/race/cantrip/item display names), and internal STAT_LABELS and TAG_LABELS mappings.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: General utility functions: calculateMultiplierFromPct (pct to multiplier), multiplyMultipliers, roundMultiplier (4 decimal places), applyScalingMult (positive/negative scaling), scalingEq (display string), calcWardingDebuffMultiplier, escapeHtml, highlightText (HTML mark wrapping), highlightTextParts (structured highlight segments), and calcProcChance (base chance × proc coefficient with scaling modes). Imports ProcCoefficient/ProcScalingType from ./types.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point. Mounts the Svelte App component to #app DOM element, imports global CSS (app.css), and injects Vercel analytics tracking. Only 7 lines.

nodes.name: ModalSearchHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: Composite modal header component providing a title, search input with autocomplete suggestions (SuggestDrop), optional tag filtering (TagFilter), optional stat filtering (StatFilter or WeaponStatFilter), and optional sort mode buttons (Highest/Most Effective/Brawny). Accepts many props to configure visibility and behavior of child components. Dispatches events: select, toggle, clear, change, weaponStatFilterChange. Uses Svelte 4 export props and createEventDispatcher.

nodes.name: MountIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Inline SVG component rendering a horse/mount icon. Accepts a size prop (default 16). Uses a random UID for gradient IDs to avoid collisions. Contains ~30 SVG path elements with detailed horse artwork in grey/blue tones.

nodes.name: PropellingFunTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: Interactive UI component for configuring the Propelling Fun perk settings: jump element (Air/Fire) and buff mode (Air Only/Fire Only/Both). Uses slider inputs with segmented visual tracks, button toggles, and dot indicators. Reads/writes to the build store (propellingFunElement, propellingFunBuffMode). Styled with per-element colors, glow effects, and smooth transitions.

nodes.name: ScalingBreakdownRow.svelte
nodes.summary: Single row component in a damage scaling breakdown display. Shows a stat type (with colored dot), its scaling multiplier, boost percentage, and final contribution. Optionally rounds multipliers and shows zero boosts. Uses grid layout with columns: type, value, ×, boost, =, contribution. Imports roundMultiplier from utils and PERCENT_STATS from types.

nodes.name: StatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Expandable armor stat filter component. Provides positive/negative tab switching, three stat groups (Boost/Defense/Utility) for both positive and negative stats, and sort modes (Highest/Lowest/ABC). Uses a tri-state filter system (off/include/exclude) via StatChip components. Dispatches 'change' events with the filter map and sort mode. Imports from elementalBoosts, filterActions, uiConstants, StatFilterShared, Badge, and Button.

nodes.name: SuggestDrop.svelte
nodes.summary: Search suggestion dropdown component. Displays a list of suggestions (each with label and type 'name'|'perk') below a search input. Highlights matching text segments using highlightTextParts from utils. Dispatches 'select' event on mousedown. Styled with absolute positioning, scrollable, and purple accent theme.

nodes.name: TagFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Expandable tag filter component for filtering items by combat/support/status/weapon-art/special tags. Defines five tag groups with associated colors from uiConstants. Supports hiding specific tags via hideTags prop. Shows summary chips of active tags in the collapsed bar, with a Clear All button. Dispatches 'toggle' and 'change' events. Uses Badge component for count display.

nodes.name: WeaponStatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Weapon-specific stat filter component with three groups: Damage Type (true/physical/magic/fire/water/earth/air/hex/holy/summon), Scaling (dexterity + all elementals), and Boost/Stats (elemental boosts plus defense/utility stats). Uses tri-state filter (off/include/exclude) via StatChip. Exposes a matchesFilter() method for external use. Imports from elementalBoosts, filterActions, uiConstants, StatFilterShared, Badge, and Button.

nodes.name: WeaponStatsDisplay.svelte
nodes.summary: Read-only display component for weapon stats. Accepts a stats record and splits it into three visual groups: Damage Types (suffix 'Type'), Scalings (suffix 'Scaling'), and Boosts/Stats (everything else). Each group rendered as colored pills with formatted labels. Negative boost values shown in red. Uses key suffix heuristics for categorization.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration. Configures Svelte plugin, VitePWA (with autoUpdate, workbox caching for HTML navigation via StaleWhileRevalidate, and PWA manifest), and rollup-plugin-visualizer (stats.html output). Uses VITE_BASE_PATH env variable for base path (defaults to '/voxlblade-builder/'). Disables manual chunk splitting.
